title: Phone-Based Postpartum Continuing Care for Smoking Cessation
brief_summary: Smoking is a leading cause of death and other negative health outcomes. While a high percentage of women quit smoking during pregnancy, the majority relapse in the first 6 months postpartum. We propose developing and pilot testing a phone-based postpartum continuing care (PPCC) protocol based on existing evidence-based approaches to increase smoking cessation, reduce relapse, increase early re-intervention, and reduce infant exposure to environmental tobacco smoke in the postpartum period.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* first or second trimester of pregnancy
* age 18 or older
* self-reported tobacco use in the past 90 days or nicotine-dependence in the past year

Exclusion Criteria:

* intend to terminate their pregnancy
* intend to move out of the city within the next 12 months
* are unable to provide informed consent and participate in English
